section: # -- client_optional_functions.csv: Client-specific workbook sections and optional planning modules to include or exclude.

label: charts_dashboard
notes: Sheet 8 - Charts Dashboard (all visual charts consolidated here)

label: asset_location
notes: Sheet 24 - Asset Location (which assets in which tax bucket)

label: current_vs_proposed
notes: Sheet 37 - Current vs Proposed recommendation deltas

label: hsa_drawdown
notes: Sheet 11C - HSA Drawdown (drawdown order for HSA dollars; content also needs hsa_withdrawal_mode = optimize)

label: spending_tracker_ytd
notes: Spending Tracker / YTD — tracks this year's real transactions and blends them into the current-year projection. One switch: also turns off Sheet 29 Spending Summary and Sheet 25 Account Reconciliation, which are its output.

label: housing_location_search
notes: Next Housing Move ("Where to live") — the Strategy → Optimize panel that screens ZIP codes and ranks places to move. Off hides the panel and stops /api/housing/optimize and /api/housing/zip-screen from running; the plan also ignores your saved home sale, next housing steps and state-over-time rows (they are kept, not deleted) and assumes you stay in your current home and state.
